summary.headline: Dedication to Charles
summary.text: Dedication in verse praising Charles and presenting Messahala’s astrological books as guides to auspicious and adverse times, wars, peace, plague, famine, sterility, fertility, and the fates of peoples and kings. The poem invokes Achilles, Julius Caesar, and celestial signs including Arcturus, the Hyades, the Pleiades, and the Bear.
